code_first.code:
memoryFree = 600
memoryNeeded = 400
if memoryFree >= memoryNeeded then
    print("Run program")
endif
p: Explain the first assignment or condition that determines the output.
Explain how this relates to memory management.
code_first.a: Run program; no output; OS manages whether resources can be allocated.

original_exam_questions: Memory management, process scheduling, file management, user interface or peripherals (any two).
Explain process scheduling in multitasking. [3 marks]
The OS allocates CPU time to processes so multiple programs can make progress.
Give one benefit of GUI over CLI. [2 marks]
Many users find labelled visual controls easier to learn/use.

optional_original_challenge.coreHint: Memory needed must not exceed memory free for this simple check.

stretch.task: Add a calculation of how much RAM remains after admitting a program.

mastery.task: Design a resource allocator for several requested program sizes; admit one at a time and keep a running free-memory total without becoming negative.
mastery.answer: With 600MB free and requests [200,450,150], accept200 (400 left), reject450, accept150 (250 left).
